title: Computer control
description: Let the assistant see your screen to help you fix problems and work in Unity, Blender, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve, VS Code… This version is VIEW-ONLY: the assistant takes screenshots and guides you; it never clicks or types.
enableHelp: Off by default. When on, the emergency stop hotkey is registered with Windows; the assistant can only see your screen after you also turn on "Allow screen viewing" in each session.
modeView: Current mode: VIEW-ONLY — screenshots and advice. Mouse/keyboard actions are not enabled in this version.

warning.title: Before enabling computer control
warning.lead: This is an experimental feature. Please read carefully before enabling it.
points: When you allow it, the assistant takes screenshots and sends them to Claude (counts toward your Claude plan). Screenshots may contain anything on screen — close windows with sensitive information (passwords, banking, private messages) first.
Every capture is logged with its image on your computer for 7 days so you can review it.
Press {{hotkey}} at any time (even in another app) to stop immediately: screen viewing is turned off and all running replies are stopped.
This version is view-only: the assistant does not click, type or open apps. Actions will only be enabled with a separate confirmation.
The assistant must never enter passwords or payment details for you.
warning.confirm: I have read and understand the points above.

errors.not_enabled: Enable computer control (and check the emergency stop hotkey) first.
